description: Create a new scene in your 3dCMS account and return its id: empty, or with copyFrom a full COPY of one of your scenes (Save As), the way to try a big change on a new version while the original and its published site stay untouched. Build it up with apply_ops. It appears in your account and opens in the 3dCMS editor; a copy is unpublished until publish_scene.

copyFrom.description: A scene id from list_scenes to copy every node, material and setting from. Omit for an empty scene.

name.description: A name for the new scene.

name: create_scene
title: Create a 3dCMS scene
